Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE individual square PNG ability icon for Mysteries Above, coherent with the approved Fool, Door, Sun and Justiciar sets. Single full-canvas icon, no sheet, atlas, montage or presentation margins. High-quality disciplined PIXEL ART on a strict 32x32 LOGICAL PIXEL GRID, magnified with crisp nearest-neighbor square blocks, broad connected clusters and stepped shading. Important silhouette and objects must be readable at 15x15 and 16x16: thick 2-3 logical-pixel contours, very few tiny details. Distinct central silhouette fills about 24 logical pixels; interesting detail at large size. No painterly texture, smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, photorealism or 3D. Same thin PLAIN neutral silver gunmetal square bevel ON THE CANVAS EDGES: pale upper/left, charcoal lower/right and one dark inset, no ornament. Nearly black cool interior #101311 and strong negative space. DEATH PATHWAY PRIMARY RGB exact #728F6C (114,143,108), desaturated moss/sage GREEN, NOT cyan, neon lime, gold or monochrome gray. Increase VALUE using pale sage #AAC6A0 and mint-bone #D9E6CF in limited hot light, retain clearly GREEN identity. Green must visibly dominate luminous chromatic clusters, roughly two thirds of lit colored area. Harmonious secondary colors only where mechanism/material supports them: muted lilac spirits, slate-blue frost, aged ivory bone, dark earth-brown, small burgundy or copper offering. No rainbow speckles. Contrast strong and glow controlled locally, no fuzzy bloom. No text, letters, numerals, writing, readable runes, glyphs, icons within UI panels, watermark, logo or religious crosses. Ability determines concept; no universal skull repeated across powers.
Ability death_undead_knowledge / Знання нежиті. A large undead skull in three-quarter CUTAWAY, a broad moss-sage luminous fracture on its temple precisely exposes its weak anatomy. Main skull surfaces tinted primary sage-green #728F6C with pale mint-green highlights, only small aged ivory teeth/edge; muted violet shadow in the empty eye socket and brown specimen ledge. This is analytical knowledge of undead weaknesses and causes of death, not an attacking skull projectile. One clear crack/node, no eye observer, no notebook or symbols.

Main green ghost and green-lit page edges, smaller aged ivory paper plane, purple spirit interior, dark brown binding. Actual passive understands dead souls, their kind, allegiance and weaknesses. Symbolic knowledge illustration, not a cast recipe or spellbook UI. NO writing, letters, diagram labels, readable runes or tiny symbols on pages.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE individual square PNG ability icon for Mysteries Above, coherent with the approved Fool, Door, Sun and Justiciar sets. Single full-canvas icon, no sheet, atlas, montage or presentation margins. High-quality disciplined PIXEL ART on a strict 32x32 LOGICAL PIXEL GRID, magnified with crisp nearest-neighbor square blocks, broad connected clusters and stepped shading. Important silhouette and objects must be readable at 15x15 and 16x16: thick 2-3 logical-pixel contours, very few tiny details. Distinct central silhouette fills about 24 logical pixels; interesting detail at large size. No painterly texture, smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, photorealism or 3D. Same thin PLAIN neutral silver gunmetal square bevel ON THE CANVAS EDGES: pale upper/left, charcoal lower/right and one dark inset, no ornament. Nearly black cool interior #101311 and strong negative space. DEATH PATHWAY PRIMARY RGB exact #728F6C (114,143,108), desaturated moss/sage GREEN, NOT cyan, neon lime, gold or monochrome gray. Increase VALUE using pale sage #AAC6A0 and mint-bone #D9E6CF in limited hot light, retain clearly GREEN identity. Green must visibly dominate luminous chromatic clusters, roughly two thirds of lit colored area. Harmonious secondary colors only where mechanism/material supports them: muted lilac spirits, slate-blue frost, aged ivory bone, dark earth-brown, small burgundy or copper offering. No rainbow speckles. Contrast strong and glow controlled locally, no fuzzy bloom. No text, letters, numerals, writing, readable runes, glyphs, icons within UI panels, watermark, logo or religious crosses. Ability determines concept; no universal skull repeated across powers.
Ability death_language_of_the_dead / Мова мертвих. At far left a cropped speaking mouth sends one thick sage-green voice ribbon toward a dark STANDING body low right. A large luminous sage-green human SOUL rises OUTSIDE and above that body's left shoulder, attached to its chest by ONE short thick spectral tether. The body stays still, soul is visibly separate and unarmored. Pale mint-green soul is dominant light, small lavender soul underside, dull slate body and little bronze lips. Actual words force the victim's spirit out, seal powers, and tether it by its body. Unlike Voice of the Dead this soul is outside its owner. No written language, text, alphabet, weapon, gore or detached skull.

Ability death_internal_underworld / Внутрішній Загробний Світ. A FRONTAL human chest is a spectral CAGE: six broad sage-green curved rib-bars frame a deep black inner chamber containing ONE small muted-lavender captive spirit, strongly rimmed in pale green. Main glowing green rib cage and cold shoulder outlines dominate, spirit secondary but recognizable; small ivory sternum facets and slate skin shadows.
